title: Berkshire Innovations Recalls Sahara Folding Food Dehydrators Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The heater fan can fail and cause the components to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 990 (In addition, about 29 were sold in Canada).

title: CultureFly Recalls L.O.L. Surprise! Trick or Treat Subscription Boxes Sold with Metal Doll Pins Due to the Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The paint on the children's metal doll pins contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 6,600.

title: ODL Recalls Severe Weather Doorglass Inserts Due to Hurricane Zone Wind-Borne Debris Injury Hazards
summary: Under severe weather conditions, such as hurricanes, the adhesive bond holding the doorglass inserts can become separated from the door causing a risk of injury and property damage from windborne debris. Units: About 39,100.

title: Polaris Recalls MATRYX RMK KHAOS and PRO Snowmobiles Due to Fire Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: When the rider engages the throttle and brake (including the parking brake) simultaneously on the recalled snowmobiles, the brake system can overheat in the caliper/pad/brake rotor area, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to the rider. title: Ricky Powersports Recalls Youth All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Violation of Federal ATV Safety Standard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death
summary: The recalled ATVs fail to comply with the mandatory requirements of the federal ATV safety standard, including parking brake requirements, posing a collision hazard to consumers if the vehicle is parked on an incline. The ATVs also fail to comply with other mandatory safety requirements for ATVs int

title: The Company Store Recalls Children's White Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at thecompanystore.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled children's white robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 930.

title: Walker Edison Furniture Recalls Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds Due to Fall and Impact Hazards
summary: The wooden slats supporting the bunk beds can break while in use, posing fall and impact hazards. Units: About 121,000.

title: Acme United Recalls PhysiciansCare Brand Allergy Relief and Cold and Cough Tablets Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning; Sold on Amazon.com
summary: The recalled products contain diphenhydramine hydrochloride and acetaminophen which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young

title: Cole & Mason 505WEG Pepper Mills Recalled by DKB Household Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Wegmans Food Markets (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled pepper mills contain a metal grinding mechanism that lets off metal "shards" for the first 10 grinds, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 9,340.

title: CPSC Warns Consumers to Immediately Stop Using BQQZHZ Combination Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detectors Due to Failure to Alert Consumers to Deadly Smoke and Fire; Sold on Amazon.com
summary: The detectors can fail to alert consumers to the presence of hazardous smoke and fire. Units: About 25,000.

title: Cycle Force Recalls Adult Bike Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability requirement of the CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 1,750.

title: Empower Brands Recalls PowerXL Stuffed Wafflizer Waffle Makers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Hot pieces of the waffle or stuffing can be expelled from the waffle maker during use or upon opening the product, posing a burn risk to consumers. Units: About 456,000.

title: Kell Electronic Recalls Personal Chiller Mini Gamer Refrigerators Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The refrigerator's power cord can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 25,000.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Pro XP and Turbo R Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A fuel leak can occur at the fuel pump assembly joint on the fuel tank in close proximity to a hot surface, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 20,330 (In addition, about 330 were sold in Canada) (Some of these vehicles were previously recalled in May 2021 and November 2020).

title: Shimano Recalls PRO Vibe Alloy Stems for Road Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled bicycle stems can crack and break while in use and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury to the user in a crash. Units: About 400 (In addition, about 90 were sold in Canada).

title: Target Recalls Nearly Five Million Threshold Candles Due to Laceration and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The candle's jar can crack or break during use, posing laceration and burn hazards. Units: About 4.9 million.

title: Advanced EV Recalls Advent 4 and 6 Passenger Golf Carts Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The golf cart's front seat can become loose due to missing rubber grommets, posing fall and injury hazards to operators and/or passengers. Units: About 2,500.

title: American Woodmark Recalls to Repair Continental Cabinets and Hampton Bay Kitchen Wall Cabinets Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The cabinets can detach from the wall, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 235,000.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products (BRP) Expands Recall of Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel injector hose retainer screw can loosen and cause a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 12,500 (In addition, about 8,000 were sold in Canada) (Some of these snowmobiles were previously recalled in October 2022).

title: Peloton Recalls Two Million Exercise Bikes Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bike's seat post assembly can break during use, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. Units: About 2.2 million.

title: Positec Recalls Blue Ridge Utility Knives Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The recalled utility knife can become unlocked and the blade can protrude only while in the original packaging, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 36,250.

title: World Market Recalls Cocktail Shakers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass cocktail shakers can crack and break during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 6,300.

title: Bunch Bikes Recalls The Preschool Electric Bicycles Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban; Lead Poisoning Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The paint on the recalled electric bikes contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 150.

title: Juratoys Recalls Children's Activity Tables Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The activity table contains a silver metal bell which can detach from its metal arch, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,080 (In addition, about 1,030 were sold in Canada).

title: The Good and the Beautiful Recalls Math 1 and Math 3 Boxes Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The paint on the recalled electric bikes contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a lead poisoning hazard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 103,200 (In addition, about 1,820 units sold in Canada).
